comment.body:
Well, let me give a first tentative response by quoting a few statements I made in posts on X on October 14, 2026:

"So many bots and not-so-rigorous minds want to know if I "believe in viruses", if I have "chosen a side".

It's not a religion. I deal in evidence and logic, not cult membership.

One relevant principle is: Absence of evidence is not proof of absence. I take that seriously.

Your time would be better spent learning by study rather than recruiting members."

Followed up by:

"Just to be clear, my sole purpose in this post was to push back against the obnoxious repeated demands that I side with a cult and profess my adherence.

The actual debate of the issue is a separate matter. There is much evidence (valid or not) that [an entity they call] viruses play a role in respiratory conditions and the said evidence can be critically assessed. So far, I have not found a conclusive body of evidence, and my critical evaluation of the science continues. I have written about it for those who read. And I plan more written reports. The Koch test is a valid positivity test but it is not the only route to demonstrate viruses [if they exist]. A demonstration does not need to involve separation and purification. That is why invalidating the proposed evidence is more complex than the meme argument anchored in Koch."

Basically, I am slow because I am rigorous. Still working on it. When I conclude, I will make my arguments explicit.

The absence of spread and contagion we already proved, so the virus thing is important only as a propaganda and financial-manipulation device, but it is not fundamentally important if you think about it. Why obsess on their invisible agent? And why obsess over me expressing a belief?

Read my latest overview: https://correlation-canada.org/eight-pivotal-facts-covid-period-mortality/

postSelection.text: What was sold as a novel respiratory virus in 2020 was a chemical operation. The clinical illness in early 2020 was produced by aerosolized industrial compounds. The hospital deaths were produced by medical protocols implemented under emergency cover. The injuries attributed to the injections were produced by the delivery vehicle in the countermeasure — the same class of molecule that produced the illness the countermeasure was marketed to prevent. The reported pandemic itself was produced by media saturation and coordinated policy across nations that had no shared exposure to any biological agent.

Another great bit of level-headed exposition, Daniel! What you say here can’t be refuted, only denied.

I’m not sure if you got into it (paywall) but what do you make of the fact that the foundational promise of Zionism and the Israeli state proves their Jews-first-always ethno-supremacism? Not just that, but their genocidal intent?

“Genocidal intent” might sound like going too far, but it’s not. A person who is 100% willing to mass murder, if need be, possesses genocidal intent. The fact that it’s generalized and conditional does not make it less than genocidal. In fact, it makes the intent more deliberate and more principled than, say, some leader who loses their mind and pushes the red button.

Now scale that to an entire regime that has demonstrated its genocidal intent beyond reasonable doubt in a nation of people that not only allowed it and continue to tolerate it, but rabidly cheer it on.

If there were ever question about the genocidal intent of Zionism, Israel has now empirically proven beyond reasonable doubt just how genocidal implemented Zionism is. All things considered, I would argue necessarily genocidal.

At this point, it is clear to me that the foundational promise of Zionism and the Israeli state is Jewish safety by means of Jewish supremacy up to and including genocide of non-Jews.

I’ve seen no reason to think, let alone facts that indicate, a significant difference in Zionist attitudes toward Palestinian goyim, Arab goyim, Persian goyim, Kurdish goyim, or any other goyim except that Palestinian and Arab and Persian goyim are the enemies du jour.

What the Zionists are allowed to do to one they’ll eventually do to the rest if and when they decide another genocide is “necessary”.
